eligible_cohort: legacy current-label legal cross-class equal-size direct AC; ordinary manual primary original-target pools; n=14,m=7 and n=20,m=7
physical_pair_identity: canonical unordered exact A/C teams bound to same pool/reference; keep all original event aliases
choice: minimum hex SHA256 of UTF8("202611041302|" + canonical_pair_id) within each stratum; tie canonical_pair_id ascending
analysis: Native minimum_support must equal ceil(n/2), same in A/C.
Stable anchored identity: exact same nonempty common-D observation key set (object_id,source_pair_index) in one native group of A and C.
Record threshold crossing only for stable anchors, plus counts and ambiguity for other overlaps and unanchored groups.
Common-D coassignment change uses all pairs of exactly shared original observations, not local feature names.
Connection correspondence compares selected-group order through stable anchored correspondence only when all selected nodes map bijectively; otherwise record unmappable/reconfigured.
Q jump >=5 and >=10 use absolute C-A only on original jointly scored support; no-Q transitions separately use all frozen selected pairs.
Aggregate within pool/image, keep n14/m7 and n20/m7 separate, report pooled image/building and co-occurrence counts without a causal claim.
No independence claim for team pairs sharing people/images; reverse views are algebraically coupled.
case_relation: Post-outcome illustrated cases are separate from this outcome-blind diagnostic sample.
